planner_response.task: Pick up the mint green scissors by 10 cm.

setup.binding: Use the right gripper. Target the solid mint plastic neck between the handle holes and metal pivot. Pinch its opposing exterior edges; never target a handle hole, blade reflection, or empty bounding-box center. Keep the left arm stationary.

camera_features.correspondences: Match equally named high/right features; refine seeds before triangulation. Pixel coordinates are approximate.

setup.assumptions: The local wooden tabletop is planar. Scissors initially rest approximately flat, with thin metal blades and thicker plastic handles. Estimate actual material contours and thickness; do not substitute an upright cuboid. Public X5 geometry supplies pad surfaces, aperture, TCP transforms and collision meshes.
setup.unsupported: RGB cannot establish contact force, friction, hidden underside shape, or native success. Joint aperture alone cannot establish capture.

processing.refresh: Recompute after every action using fresh synchronized RGB, calibration and robot state. Update wrist extrinsics from public kinematics. Initial ROIs only initialize tracking.
processing.geometry: Use camera-local rays [(u-cx)/fx, -(v-cy)/fy, -1] for the supplied graphics-camera convention; verify reprojection and positive forward range. Match named features and textured table patches across high/right views. Triangulate robustly and fit a table plane to at least 20 spatially distributed table matches, excluding objects and robot.
processing.material: Segment mint plastic by color and edges, explicitly subtracting handle holes. Track metal boundaries separately. Fit a planar scissors contour with separately estimated plastic and metal thickness intervals from visible side edges. Select the neck cross-section maximizing solid pad overlap and table clearance. Derive closing direction across its exterior edges and pad orientation from the local contour.
processing.uncertainty: Propagate 2-pixel feature uncertainty and calibration/reprojection residuals. Set positional uncertainty u=max(0.003 m, propagated 95-percent error). Reject geometry if u>0.012 m. Never require alignment finer than u.
processing.grasp_geometry: Let w be measured neck width along closing direction, A measured inner-pad aperture, and P the public pad geometry. Open clearance is A-w-2u. Compute actual pad/material intersection intervals, excluding holes, and swept pad/table clearance. Select a capture height with both pads overlapping the estimated plastic sidewall by at least u while their lower surfaces clear the table by u. If no such interval exists, use the bounded recovery.
processing.residuals: Position errors are target-minus-current TCP components in world meters; rotation errors are the world rotation-log components in radians. Normalize pad/material overlap by available solid pad area. Derive yaw tolerance as max(0.10 rad, atan2(2u, usable neck length)).

actor_interface.format: English structured text containing phase, permitted transitions, confidence, and only that phase's fields below. No images, future-phase metrics, or approach-stage attachment drift.
actor_interface.actions: Categorical world XYZ and rotation signs, gripper command, and phase transition; the fixed executor bounds each action.

stages.name: approach_open
stages.pass: Above the selected neck, lateral error <=max(0.008 m,2u), orientation within derived tolerances, open clearance >=2u, and collision-free descent corridor.

stages.name: engage_material
stages.pass: Within the feasible capture-height interval, each predicted pad overlap >=0.25, lateral error <=max(0.008 m,2u), and table clearance >=u.

stages.name: close
stages.pass: Closure completes or aperture changes by less than u across two action results, with neck still between pads. Store scissors and TCP baselines; immediately advance to active lift.

stages.name: capture_lift_test
stages.pass: Actively lift by max(0.030 m,3u). At least three visible material landmarks show upward gain exceeding 2u, and attachment displacement change <=2u. Otherwise recover.

stages.name: raise_10cm
stages.pass: Triangulate both handle landmarks and blade tip. For every landmark, its table-normal height gain from the preclosure baseline minus propagated gain uncertainty is >=0.100 m. Preserve initial scissors orientation within uncertainty; stop lifting immediately when passed.

stages.name: complete
stages.pass: Keep gripping. Successful pickup requires no release.

bounded_recovery.limit: One recovery total; then report failure if geometry or capture remains inadequate.
bounded_recovery.missing_geometry: With gripper open and clear, move the right wrist laterally by at most 0.03 m through a collision-free corridor, recompute geometry once, and retry approach.
bounded_recovery.failed_capture: If scissors remain held, lower toward their original table support using visible geometry. Once supported within uncertainty, open. Physically retreat upward until pads clear the uncertainty-expanded scissors contour by max(0.020 m,2u). Require scissors height to remain within 2u of table support during retreat. Recompute the material grasp and retry once.

provenance.status: Current initial RGB based proposal; not an executed or successful controller
